Definition: to clasp (the hands or in embrace)
BiblicalUsage: Chabaq means to embrace, to clasp in the arms. Laban ran and embraced Jacob when he came, Elisha promised the Shunammite woman she would embrace a son, the poor embrace the rock for want of a shelter, and wisdom says to embrace her and she will bring you to honour.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe an embrace in Scripture is never small: it is welcome, promise, shelter, and honour all at once. God embraces His people the way Laban embraced Jacob — running to meet them, not waiting to be asked.
